title: Annual Budget Planner
description: Households: plan the year's income, bills and savings, then compare with actuals.

spec.useCase: Imani Brooks plans each month and checks plan against actual at year end.

business.name: Imani Brooks household
business.describes: One person planning her year of income and spending.

tables.name: Budget lines
tables.describes: Every planned income, fixed, variable and savings line with its monthly amount.
tables.subject: thing

fields.label: Plan used (%)
fields.formula: IF({Planned monthly} > 0, ROUND({Actual this month} / {Planned monthly} * 100, 0), 0)

fields.label: Plan state
fields.formula: IF({Type} = "Income", IF({Actual this month} >= {Planned monthly}, "Income on plan", "Income below plan"), IF({Actual this month} > {Planned monthly}, "Over plan", "Within plan"))
